summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biographical entry on Brandon Crawford, an American professional baseball shortstop for the San Francisco Giants of Major League Baseball. It highlights two notable achievements: a grand slam in his first MLB game and the first postseason grand slam by an MLB shortstop. It also notes his college career at UCLA, where he was twice named team MVP.
one_line: Brandon Crawford is an American MLB shortstop for the San Francisco Giants known for a debut grand slam and his UCLA career.
key_facts: Brandon Michael Crawford was born on January 21, 1987.
Brandon Crawford is an American professional baseball shortstop.
Brandon Crawford plays for the San Francisco Giants of Major League Baseball (MLB).
Brandon Crawford was the sixth player in MLB history to hit a grand slam in his first Major League game.
Brandon Crawford is the first shortstop to hit a grand slam in a Major League Baseball postseason game.
Brandon Crawford played college baseball for the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA).
Brandon Crawford was twice named the UCLA baseball team's Most Valuable Player (MVP).
